fusions.name: Idle Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks water at a target up to 7 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, with a 25% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Calm Regard
fusions.desc: You sweep a 5-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to everything in it and leaving it [Stalled] for 6 seconds, its abilities coming back slower.

fusions.name: Shed Like Water
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: When your health fills, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
